subject: KMS archival proofset request & snapshot endorsement
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@bluepeak.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: archival proofset for CAIQ / SIG — BluePeak onboarding

Hi Naomi,

We're preparing the CAIQ and need a sample proofset demonstrating Redwood's encryption archival and key lifecycle for tenant data. Specifically we need:
- a manifest of archived encrypted objects with object ids and envelope-key references (redacted ok)
- a KMS rotation snapshot covering the last 12 months (rotation events + admin audit ids)
- HSM attestation or vendor report for the HSM cluster used to wrap KEKs

Can you confirm whether you can provide a redacted sample set and the timeframe for delivery? Our security review is on a tight cadence — ideally by end of next week.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Lead Security Engineer
BluePeak Systems
compliance@bluepeak.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-09T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: archival proofset for CAIQ / SIG — BluePeak onboarding

Samir — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a redacted proofset. Proposed artifacts:
- archival_manifest.csv (redacted object ids + envelope references)
- kms_rotation_snapshot-2027-07-31.log (rotation events + admin actor ids, redacted)
- hsm-attestation-2027-06.pdf (vendor-signed attestation; we will confirm allowable redaction)

Plan and owners:
- Marissa will assemble the archival manifest and logs and run redaction.
- Jonas will coordinate any vendor HSM permission/attestation sharing and confirm if an NDA amendment is required.

Target delivery: initial package by 2027-08-11 EOD PT. If BluePeak needs WORM/immutable storage verification excerpt, tell us and we'll include a signed excerpt.

Attachments: we'll attach a manifest stub and a rotation snapshot sample in the next message.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Product Security
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-09T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: archival proofset for CAIQ / SIG — BluePeak onboarding

Hi all — attaching the redacted samples as discussed.

Attached:
- archival_manifest.csv (CSV) — shows redacted object keys, bucket region, envelope id reference
- kms_rotation_snapshot-2027-07-31.log (log) — rotation events, rotation type (scheduled/manual), admin actor ids redacted
- hsm-attestation-2027-06.pdf (pdf) — vendor attestation, redaction applied to serials

Notes:
- We replaced tenant ids with stable hashes; envelope references are truncated to 8 chars for privacy.
- The KMS snapshot includes SHA256 hashes of candidates for non-repudiation; raw keys are never included.
- If BluePeak requires a notarized timestamp or a signed hash of the archive we can produce a signed manifest (PKCS7) — indicate preference.

Marissa Cole
Security Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs: archival_manifest.csv, kms_rotation_snapshot-2027-07-31.log, hsm-attestation-2027-06.pdf]

From: Samir Patel <samir@bluepeak.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, compliance@bluepeak.com
Date: 2027-08-10T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: archival proofset for CAIQ / SIG — BluePeak onboarding

Naomi / Marissa — received the samples, thanks. They look good on first pass. Two quick follow-ups before we close:
1) Can you attach the excerpt from your data retention policy that governs archived encrypted objects (we need the clause and effective date)?
2) Please confirm whether archived objects are written to immutable/WORM storage for the first 90 days after archival, and whether the preservation is enforced by access control + object lock.

If you can drop those items into the same folder (or send a signed excerpt), we'll route to our SOC reviewer. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Samir Patel
Lead Security Engineer
BluePeak Systems
